sites.name: Con Son - Kiep Bac Relic Site
sites.event: A special national relic site associated with the lives and careers of the historical figures Nguyen Trai, Tran Hung Dao, and Chu Van An.

place.commune: Cong Hoa Ward, Hung Dao Commune

sites.name: Chi Lang Nam Stork Island
sites.event: A unique nature reserve with tens of thousands of storks and herons nesting in the middle of An Duong Lake.

sites.name: Mao Dien Temple of Literature
sites.event: The venue for the regional imperial examinations of the former Hai Duong province, symbolizing the studious tradition of the Eastern region (ranking second only to the Temple of Literature - Quoc Tu Giam in scale).

sites.name: Chu Dau Pottery Village
sites.event: The cradle of the once-lost premium blue-and-white pottery, known as 'gom dao', which is currently being strongly restored and developed.

sites.name: Kinh Chu Cave (Duong Nham Cave)
sites.event: Named the 'Sixth Cave of the Southern Sky' by King Le Thanh Tong, it preserves a valuable system of cliff-carved steles (ma nhai).

sites.name: Tranh Temple (Quan Lon Tuan Tranh Temple)
sites.event: The place of worship for Quan Lon Tuan Tranh, the deity guarding the waterways, and a famous spiritual site in the Mother Goddess worship belief.

sites.name: Cao An Phu Temple
sites.event: The place of worship for An Sinh Vuong Tran Lieu (father of Hung Dao Vuong Tran Quoc Tuan), located atop the majestic An Phu Mountain.

sites.name: Thanh Mai Pagoda Maple Forest
sites.event: A rare ancient sweetgum forest in the North, where the leaves turn a brilliant red in winter.

sites.name: Bia Temple
sites.event: The place of worship for the Great Physician Tue Tinh - the founder of Vietnamese traditional medicine, famous for the saying 'Nam duoc tri Nam nhan'.

sites.name: Thanh Ha Lychee Garden (The Ancestral Lychee Tree)
sites.event: The ancestral land of Vietnamese lychee, home to the nearly 200-year-old Hoang Nghi ancestral lychee tree.

sites.name: Giam Pagoda (Nghiem Quang Pagoda)
sites.event: Preserving the ancient and most valuable wooden Cuu Pham Lien Hoa (Nine-tier Lotus Tower) in Vietnam (a National Treasure).
